job.name: Afterschool Nanny in Newport Coast (6YO & 11YO)
job.description:
Afterschool Nanny in Newport Coast (6YO & 11YO)


Children: 6-year-old and 11-year-old (two boys: one born in December 2019 and the other born in July 2015)

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 2:30 PM–6:30 PM (20 hours/week)

Pay: $18–$20/hour base pay

Location: Newport Coast, CA 92657

Commitment: 12+ months preferred


Hello,


Are you smart, capable, and always ready for an adventure? If so, this may be the perfect childcare opportunity for you!


At Jovie Newport Beach, we believe in the magic of childhood and are looking for caregivers who share our passion for helping children learn, grow, and thrive. If babysitting feels more like play than work and you naturally gravitate toward engaging with kids, we’d love to meet you.


For over 20 years, Jovie (formerly College Nannies + Sitters) has been a trusted childcare provider serving families across the United States. Our mission is simple: Building Stronger Families. We provide our caregivers with support, flexibility, and opportunities to make a meaningful difference in the lives of local families.


Your Role:

A warm and welcoming family in Newport Coast is seeking a dependable, mature, and engaging afterschool nanny for their two children, ages 6 and 11. The children are kind, well-behaved, follow instructions well, and get along with one another.


The family is looking for someone who can provide a consistent and positive presence in the children’s lives while helping them transition smoothly from school into their afternoon routines. The ideal nanny will be calm, loving, professional, and confident taking the lead while maintaining a warm relationship with the children.


The family lives in a spacious home with a pool, playroom, movie room, and dedicated spaces for schoolwork. The household also includes a live-in maid and occasional instructors, including tutors and music teachers. Mom and Dad are described as supportive and gentle and are available to provide guidance when needed.


This is a wonderful opportunity for an experienced nanny who enjoys working with school-aged children and can bring structure, positivity, and fun to their afternoons.


The family is hoping to find someone who is committed to building a long-term relationship and becoming a trusted, stable part of the children’s lives.


Responsibilities include:

• Providing attentive, engaging, and age-appropriate care for both children after school.

• Helping the children transition from school into their afternoon routines.

• Ensuring homework and schoolwork are completed before free time, as appropriate.

• Supporting the children’s instrument practice and other academic or extracurricular responsibilities.

• Driving the children to extracurricular activities, school functions, playdates, shopping trips, and other age-appropriate outings.

• Supporting activities such as tennis, golf, basketball, swimming, and other interests.

• Planning and participating in fun, engaging activities with the children.

• Encouraging the children to spend time playing, being active, and enjoying age-appropriate activities.

• Preparing healthy snacks and light food for the children as needed.

• Helping maintain reasonable limits around screen time.

• Keeping the children’s playroom, belongings, and activity areas organized.

• Providing calm, consistent guidance and reinforcing household expectations.

• Handling discipline firmly but calmly and communicating with parents when additional support or guidance is needed.

• Maintaining a positive, professional presence in the home.

• Communicating with Mom and Dad regarding homework, activities, transportation, and daily updates.

• Helping create a warm, harmonious environment where the children feel supported, encouraged, and cared for.


What’s In It for You?

Competitive Pay

Earn $18–$20/hour as your base rate, with occasional opportunities to earn $20–$25/hour through special assignments and events. Pay is issued via biweekly direct deposit, and you’d receive a W-2.


Minimum Pay Protection

If you’re scheduled for a shift under four hours, you’ll still be paid for four hours. If the family cancels after 5:00 PM the night before care, you’ll receive four hours of pay.


Transportation Reimbursement

When transporting children in your personal vehicle, mileage is reimbursed at $0.76 per mile. Transportation is an important part of this position, as the nanny may drive the children to activities, school functions, playdates, and other outings.


Vetted Family

This placement is with a family we have personally met and screened. The household consists of Mom, Dad, their two boys, a teenage daughter, and a live-in maid.


Supportive Team

Our management team is available and on-call to assist with questions and concerns. We strive to create successful matches and support our nannies every step of the way.


Group Events & Additional Opportunities

Interested in earning extra income? We offer optional childcare events that pay higher rates, include travel bonuses, and provide a chance to connect with other nannies.


Benefits & Protections:

• Workers’ Compensation Coverage

• General Liability Insurance

• Accruable Sick Pay

• Late Cancellation Pay

• 401(k) Enrollment


No Upfront Costs

We invest in our caregivers by covering:

• Background checks

• CPR/First Aid certification (if needed)

• Company T-shirt and nanny bag


Referral Bonus

Earn $200 for every nanny you refer who is hired and remains with Jovie for at least 90 days.


Scheduling & Communication

Professional Tools

You’ll use the MyJovie app to view upcoming assignments/additional opportunities as well as clock in and out.


Managing Your Availability

Need a day off? We ask for notice by 4:30 PM the day before on weekdays. Weekend schedule adjustments should be communicated by 4:30 PM on Friday to avoid cancellation penalties.


Communication Style

Communication is primarily through text message. Upon hire, you’ll be added to a group chat with management and ownership. We value clear, honest, and timely communication and strive to build supportive relationships with every caregiver on our team.


Qualifications:

• Authorized to work in the United States

• At least 18 years old

• Valid U.S. driver’s license

• Reliable, insured vehicle

• CPR/First Aid certified or willing to become certified upon hire

• Willing and able to pass a background check and fingerprinting

• At least two years of childcare experience, ideally with school-aged children

• Comfortable caring for children ages 6 and 11

• Mature, calm, loving, and professional

• Able to lead with kindness while maintaining appropriate boundaries and household expectations

• Positive attitude and ability to maintain professionalism in the home

• Reliable and consistent with a strong interest in a long-term commitment

• Comfortable driving children to activities and outings

• Must reside in Orange County or Los Angeles

• Passionate about working with children while maintaining a professional relationship with families


Ready to Join Us?

Apply here. Feel free to reach out to management if you have any questions.


Office: (949) 301-9422

Hiring Manager Direct Line: (562) 343-6194

Email: newportbeachca@jovie.com

Monday–Friday | 9:00 AM–5:00 PM


Check us out on TikTok and Instagram: @joviecarenewportbeach
